# LayoutNode

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

One node in the layout tree: a rendered element and the area(s) it occupied.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new LayoutNode()
```

## Properties

- [`A11y`](#a11y): Intrinsic accessibility facts, when the element declares a role; null otherwise.
- [`Children`](#children): The nodes laid out inside this one, in render order.
- [`Id`](#id): Stable within one snapshot; assigned in deterministic render order.
- [`Name`](#name): Optional author-supplied name/key; null when unset.
- [`Paint`](#paint): Intrinsic colour/typography facts, when the element paints any; null otherwise.
- [`Rects`](#rects): The rectangles this node occupied — one per page it touched (may be empty).
- [`SourceId`](#sourceid): Optional opaque source ID supplied by an editor integration.
- [`Type`](#type): Canonical element type name, e.g. "TextBlock", "Table", "Page".
